case.summary: Card C11923-K2 was flagged for fraud after customer C11923 reported an unauthorized $131.30 purchase. The transaction was 4.6x the card’s median spend, with 8 small online authorizations under $5 in 72 hours and a new device alert. Similar past cases (CC-0290, CC-2247, CC-2673) confirm recurring fraud patterns on this card. The card was blocked, and no further evidence was requested. Exposure totaled $157.65 across multiple transactions between December 27-29, 2016.
